subject.title: feat(discord): notify agents of voice participant changes

question: Should keyed replacement on `enqueueSystemEvent` become the supported shared plugin SDK contract for Discord voice membership coalescing?
rationale: The patch is additive and well tested, but this choice defines ordering and replacement semantics for every future plugin consumer and cannot be treated as a Discord-local implementation detail once shipped.

options.title: Approve the shared contract
options.body: Keep the optional keyed replacement API, confirm its route and ordering semantics, and merge after exact-head checks are reconciled.

options.title: Keep coalescing Discord-local
options.body: Remove the plugin SDK expansion and implement pending-roster coalescing inside the Discord voice owner, accepting more plugin-local state.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared contract
recommendation.body: Keep the optional keyed replacement API, confirm its route and ordering semantics, and merge after exact-head checks are reconciled.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior merged work spans both Discord voice session routing and shared agent/session runtime behavior, which is the boundary this decision crosses.
